action_items.detail: This is a frontend-only prototype with no backend (/api is not served), so there are no backend tests. Every criterion was checked in the browser against the preview URL.

Macro placeholders use double braces ({{order.tracking_url}}), while the criterion text says {order.tracking_url}. Insert and preview both work (the preview filled in https://tracking.example.com/ups/1Z20398).

The AI tab has no Empty demo state, only Loading and Error. This seems reasonable for a settings form. Loading, Empty and Error all work on Articles, Macros, Integrations and Users. The Sandbox shows sandbox-error when the demo state is Error.

At 1440x900 on /inbox/GB-1076, the conversation column is about 552px wide. The status, priority and assignee controls sit on one line, but they wrap below the two-line subject rather than sharing a row with it.
The deactivated-article test had to toggle the seeded top sizing article ('Between sizes: which way to go') off. The check turns it back on afterwards, and data resets on reload anyway.
